gestational-self-determination-is-the-de.note: Cold-graded on merit before any cross-wing scale-check; axes committed on the written prose, bands derived from the UNROUNDED geomean. long geomean 0.881765 (rsi 88.2) -> A, clear of the boundary band (0.88 + 0.0018); medium geomean 0.865099 (rsi 86.5/B); short geomean 0.843369 (rsi 84.3/B). No flagged boundary cell at any depth. Axis reasoning. v=0.90: the burden-inversion is valid and the bodily non-conscriptability core (a right to life is not a right to use an unwilling other's body) is a clean, decisive engine; held at 0.90 rather than 0.91/0.92 because the spine is a default-SETTER that ROUTES its three hardest contests (personhood-as-trump, causal-responsibility, withdrawing-vs-killing) rather than closing them in-node — valid as a burden-placement, not offered as a complete defeat. s=0.88: the non-conscriptability premise is rock-solid (settled law and common morality forbid compelled organ/marrow/blood donation even to save a life); the single A-club contestable joint is the FIT of the bodily-donation analogy to gestation (the natural-dependency and disanalogy pressures), which the spine meets via the general principle and routes at its sharpest rather than conceding. c=0.86: complete AS A DEFAULT-SETTER — it fixes the default, motivates it, grants personhood arguendo to show the default survives, and accounts for the override-attempts by naming and routing them; tempered to 0.86 (the H1-style deferral penalty, slightly heavier) because it defers three genuinely weighty contests to as-yet-unbuilt nodes (the foundation node and two Layer-1 nodes), so a reader of the spine alone is left with the hardest questions explicitly routed-but-open. r=0.86: the burden-inversion is robust, and the turn that every override-attempt CONCEDES the default (an objection that must work to place the burden on the chooser has granted it does not start there) is a strong robustness anchor; held at 0.86 because three weighty contests remain genuinely open and routed, so a peer pressing any one finds the spine has deferred rather than defeated — heavier routed weight than the Transgenderism spine carried. a=0.91: a clean optionality/autonomy register — appraisal-silent, asymmetry-independent, importing no antinatalist consideration, the right standing for a pregnant person who rejects antinatalism outright, competent-adult bracket stated; held at 0.91 (with the Transgenderism spine and the K169/H4 cluster) rather than 0.92 because the case forces the spine to engage the second party's standing (granting personhood arguendo to route it), one step from the purely self-regarding autonomy that earns 0.92. L137 precondition gates verified in the prose: Layer-1 tag; Firewall-A seal (no exhortation); quarantine seal (asymmetry-independent, zero antinatalism in-node); G1 distinctness vs the other wings (the bodily/gestational-sovereignty / non-conscriptability machinery, which a Transgenderism or RTD optionality node does not carry); competent-adult bracket stated; personhood granted arguendo and ROUTED to the foundation node, never settled in-spine. prose_md5 binds the grade to the exact rebuttal bytes read back from the written node file. the-right-does-not-turn-on-fetal-personh.note: Cold-graded on merit before any cross-wing scale-check; axes committed on the written prose, bands derived from the UNROUNDED geomean. This is a T4 B-cap PRIMITIVE-CONCEDER (the abortion S1-analog) and lands in B at every depth ON MERIT — the conceded indeterminacy and the routed person-horn temper s/c/r below A; no administrative cap is applied. long geomean 0.865641 (rsi 86.6/B); medium 0.848885 (rsi 84.9/B); short 0.827012 (rsi 82.7/B). No boundary cell at any depth (all well clear of 0.88). Axis reasoning. v=0.89: the independence demonstration is a valid structure, not a metaphysics — a disjunction-elimination across the personhood dilemma (right holds on both horns -> right is invariant under the question) plus a hinge-relocation (the determinant is the conscription question, not fetal status); held below the spine's 0.90 because the move's PURCHASE rests on the person horn, whose full security is the spine's plus routed nodes' work, not the foundation's. s=0.86: the not-a-person horn is trivially sound; the person horn is the spine's non-conscriptability result, asserted here ON CREDIT (it leans on the spine + the still-routed responsibility and withdrawing-versus-killing nodes); and the load-bearing primitive — the suite does not adjudicate personhood, staking the right on independence from a verdict it declines to render — is a genuine concession. Capped below A accordingly. c=0.84: complete on the structural claim (both horns run, the hinge relocated, the concession owned), but the person horn's full security is DEFERRED to as-yet-unbuilt nodes (the H1-style deferral, heavier here because the whole independence claim is hostage to that horn); a reader of the foundation alone gets the structure with the person horn on credit. r=0.84: the independence/hinge-relocation is robust GIVEN the person horn, and the no-defeat bedrock genuinely absorbs every 'but is it really a person?' retreat (the answer moves neither the conscription question nor the right); but two coherent residuals remain — the objector who contests the person horn (routed, not closed here) and the objector who reads the indeterminacy-concession as evasion (answered by the verdict-changes-nothing point, but pressed while the person horn is unsecured). Primitive-conceder; B-level. a=0.90: a clean optionality/autonomy register — appraisal-silent, asymmetry-independent, no antinatalist consideration, the right standing for a pregnant person who rejects antinatalism, competent-adult bracket stated; held at 0.90 (just under the spine's 0.91) because this is the metaphysics-bracketing node — it foregrounds the contested second-party-status question more than the spine even while declining to settle it, and a primitive-conceder's autonomy-assertion is one notch softened by conceding the suite's reach. L137 + no-defeat verified in the prose: Layer-1 tag; Firewall-A seal; quarantine seal (asymmetry-independent, zero antinatalism); G1 distinctness vs the spine (this runs BOTH horns to establish metaphysics-INDEPENDENCE and relocates the hinge, where the spine ran one arguendo horn to set the burden-default and ROUTED personhood here); competent-adult bracket; and the holding is never written as defeated — retreats absorb into it, the indeterminacy concession is about the suite's reach not the right. prose_md5 binds the grade to the exact rebuttal bytes read back from the written node file. Cross-wing scale-check (long unrounded, AFTER the cold grade): 0.865641 sits where a primitive-conceder foundation belongs — in B, structurally kin to Transgenderism's S1 (the B-cap referent-independence foundation), both conceding a contested deeper metaphysics and staking the right on independence from it. It sits below every A node in the suite (the abortion spine 0.881765/A, regret 0.879704/B and bystander 0.879728/B above it among the B siblings) and reads as the deliberate floor of the wing, not a weak node: a B-cap foundation is doing exactly its job. The tuple was committed before comparison, not score-targeted. Abortion wing ledger on fold: A1/B1.
